Dither Cards

Motion·by @praveenisomer·2026-09-02·inspora page·original post

What it is

Two editorial art cards side by side ('Capital Metamorphosis' flower, 'Sensitive Dependencies' insect) rendered in black-and-white dither; the insect image morphs through metamorphosis stages (bee -> curled larva -> dark chrysalis -> butterfly) while a bottom progress bar + color-ring indicator cycle.

Media

Frame-by-frame

0-12%
Two tall white cards on a grey dithered backdrop; left card static purple-tinted dithered flower, right card shows a dithered bee; captions + pink tags below images; bottom row has a rainbow conic ring and a track bar.
12-30%
Right image crossfades/morphs to a curled creature pose; dither pattern stays crisp at all times (no blur).
30-55%
Right image morphs again into an abstract dark crumpled form (chrysalis); left flower cycles its own subtle bloom variants.
55-80%
Right image resolves into a fully-formed butterfly; progress bar has advanced steadily; ring hue rotates.
80-100%
Sequence resets: butterfly fades back to the bee; bar returns to zero; loop.

Build prompt

Rebuild this interaction 1:1: two editorial art cards rendered in crisp black-and-white dither. The right card's image morphs through metamorphosis stages (bee -> curled larva -> dark chrysalis -> butterfly) on an infinite loop while a bottom progress bar fills and a conic ring rotates hue. The left card cycles subtle bloom variants of a dithered flower.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve, canvas/shader notes are perf guidance only; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
Grey dithered backdrop. Two tall white cards, radius 12, border black/5. Each card: 3:4 image area, caption "Title / subtitle" (semibold 14px / zinc-500 12px), small pink tag chips, footer row with a 16px conic-gradient ring indicator and a 2px progress track. Prepare 4 plates of the same subject converted to 1-bit ordered dithering (Bayer 4x4) at identical dimensions.

## Motion spec
Pattern: autoplay loop (no interaction).
- Plate cycle: each plate holds ~1.5s, crossfade 400ms ease-in-out to the next (or threshold dissolve: pixels flip in dither-noise order over 400ms - crunchier and more on-theme).
- Full metamorphosis: ~6s across 4 plates.
- Progress bar: scaleX 0 -> 1 across the full 6s cycle, linear, origin left; returns to 0 on reset.
- Conic ring: hue rotates 360deg over the same 6s, linear.
- Left card: cycles its own subtle bloom variants on the same clock, offset by half a cycle.
- Reset: butterfly crossfades back to the bee (400ms), bar and ring snap to zero; loop restarts immediately.

## Calibration
- Crossfades 400ms - shorter flickers, longer muddies the dither texture.
- The dither must stay crisp at all times: images pixel-aligned, no blur filters, image-rendering: pixelated.
- Bar and ring are ambient, perfectly linear - they are clocks, not actors.

## Reduced motion
Hold on the first plate of each card. Bar and ring render static at 0.

## Don't miss
- All 4 plates must share exact dimensions and subject registration, or the morph looks like a slideshow.
- Pair the two cards: left card is the calm control, right card is the one that transforms.
- The ring hue rotation and bar fill share one clock - they must never drift apart.
